title: Global assembly of the specified diagonal orientation
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum P of [def-pur-conventions]. For separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y and a smooth separated finite-type f:X->Y of pure dimension d, let theta_f be the specified pro-etale diagonal orientation [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. Let alpha_f be the specified diagonal base-change comparison, delta_f the unique family-normalized DNC comparison, and beta_f the normal zero-section restriction of the specified ordinary diagonal orientation with its fixed Tate pullback transport t [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data, thm-pur-dnc-invariance, lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization]. Then theta_f = beta_f delta_f alpha_f^-1, as actual isomorphisms omega_f~A_X(d)[2d], without affine hypotheses on X or Y. In the published Lean names, diagonalDualizingObject P d f aY = chartDiagonalAssembly P d f aY t. The factors here are the specified ones: the statement quantifies no alternative trace, DNC comparison or adjoint transpose. It includes d=0, disconnected schemes and empty schemes.

proof.text: Choose affine target opens V and affine source opens U lying over them. Diagonal-section pasting identifies the restricted alpha with alpha_h. The family-normalization characterization of DNC and etale localization identify the restricted delta with delta_h. Vector purity, its base-change equation, and the specified finite site comparison identify the restricted beta with beta_h. Consequently each restricted three-factor assembly is the chart assembly.

source.place: Steps 1--2 and combining paragraph; affine chart normalization and restriction paragraph

proof.text: Apply diagonal_dnc_chart_normalization on every affine pair U,V. After the common shift by -2d both objects are identified with a degree-zero Tate line. The degree-zero derived-map equality test gives equality globally; shifting back gives the claimed equality of isomorphisms. The rank-zero and empty-cover clauses are retained.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalDncAssemblyGlobal (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [IsSeparated aY]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates) :
    P.diagonalDualizingObject d f aY = P.chartDiagonalAssembly d f aY t
